title: Gubser--Nellore zero-density Einstein--dilaton thermodynamics
summary: A clean-room Chebyshev reproduction of two zero-density black-hole thermodynamic curves in the five-dimensional bottom-up Einstein--dilaton model of Gubser and Nellore.

source.title: Mimicking the QCD equation of state with a dual black hole

conventions.name: bulk theory and units
conventions.value: Five bulk dimensions, metric signature (-,+,+,+,+), AdS radius L = 1, kappa_5^2 = 1
conventions.rationale: Fixes the source action, thermodynamic normalization, and dimensionless reported quantities.

conventions.name: ensemble
conventions.value: Zero chemical potential with no Maxwell field
conventions.rationale: This benchmark is Einstein--dilaton, not Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton.

conventions.name: primary radial variables
conventions.value: x = z^(4-Delta), u = x/x_H, phi = x_H u P(u), A_E = x_H^2 u^2 C(u)
conventions.rationale: The factorization imposes the leading source-normalized UV behavior on a finite exact-endpoint collocation interval.

conventions.name: Figure 3 horizontal scale
conventions.rationale: This is a single plot registration used to reproduce the displayed source coordinate; it is not a predicted critical temperature.

parameters.name: pure-cosh potential
parameters.description: Source calibration potential used for the Figure 2 curve.

parameters.name: QCD-like potential
parameters.description: Source phenomenological potential used for the Figure 3 red black-hole curve.

parameters.name: pure-cosh spectral degrees
parameters.description: Three aligned resolutions for the coupled collocation and convergence check.

parameters.name: QCD-like spectral degrees
parameters.description: Three aligned resolutions for the infrared branch and convergence check.

equations.description: The two fixed source potentials differ only in gamma and b.
Blackening equation in conformal gauge with p = 4-Delta.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (24)-(29), transformed to conformal gauge.

equations.description: Einstein equation for the source-subtracted conformal warp factor.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (24)-(29), transformed to conformal gauge.

equations.expression: phi_xx + [3 A_E,x + f_x/f + (1-4/p)/x] phi_x - exp(2 A_E) V'(phi)/(p^2 x^2 f) = 0
equations.description: Scalar equation retained at the exact horizon to impose regularity.
equations.source_ref: Source Eqs. (24)-(29), transformed to conformal gauge.

observables.name: temperature
observables.extraction: Use the exact-horizon derivative of f in conformal gauge.

observables.name: entropy density
observables.extraction: Evaluate 2 pi exp(3 A_E(z_H))/z_H^3 at the exact horizon.

observables.name: speed of sound squared
observables.extraction: Differentiate log(T) with respect to log(s) along one declared black-hole branch.

acceptance_criteria: Potential and UV algebra agree with analytic values within 1e-12.
Every final nonlinear solve succeeds with scaled collocation residual at most 1e-9.
All three physical equations pass an independently oversampled 1e-7 residual gate, including the horizon scalar equation and exact endpoints.
Successive spectral thermodynamic changes are at most 2e-4 with the declared ordering floor.
The five scalar-coordinate DOP853 comparisons agree within 5e-4 relative error.
Local barycentric and shape-preserving thermodynamic derivatives agree within 1e-3.
Figures 2 and 3 reproduce their frozen derived anchors within 1.5e-3 and 5e-3 absolute error, respectively.
Branch integrity, duplicate-run determinism, JSON, CLI, evidence, schema, and regression gates pass.

tests.expected: Potential identities, exact endpoints, coupled equations, and nonlinear residuals pass their frozen gates.
Three-level spectral refinements and five DOP853 comparisons pass the declared thresholds.
All Figure 2 and Figure 3 derived anchors and duplicate-run determinism pass the frozen contract.

claims.statement: The two fixed potentials and scalar-coordinate thermodynamic formulas are established in the cited Gubser--Nellore source model.
claims.evidence: Gubser and Nellore, arXiv:0804.0434v2, Eqs. (24)-(35) and Figures 2-3.

claims.statement: The HoloForge coupled Chebyshev implementation reproduces the selected source curves within the frozen numerical contract.
claims.evidence: Automated equation, endpoint, refinement, DOP853, derivative, figure-anchor, determinism, and interface checks in tests/test_gubser_nellore_ed.py.

limitations: This is a classical two-derivative bottom-up model and no top-down string embedding is claimed.
The benchmark is zero-density Einstein--dilaton; it contains no Maxwell field, baryon chemical potential, or EMD finite-density physics.
The QCD-like potential is phenomenological, and agreement with its source curve is not empirical validation of QCD.
T_c_plot is only a Figure 3 registration and must not be interpreted as a predicted critical temperature.
The source curves are represented by derived vector-path anchors with recorded digitization uncertainty; raw source figures are not redistributed.
The implementation and model card are AI-assisted; human approval does not erase that provenance or broaden the reproduced claim.
